comment: Coughlan is one of the most respected profs in Bschool. He weaves in personal stories to illustrate the OB topics as well as incoporating engaging simulations and exercises in class. His exams are pretty short, but quite difficult, even if you paid attention. But there are other group and single presentations/projects can balance out your grade.

Coughlan likes you to read. A lot. He's kind of bad about assigning homework the night before in some cases and most of the time it's 30 pages of reading. The class is based almost entirely on discussion about the readings and participation is a large portion of the grade so don't think you can get around it. If you care about ethics, take him.
Excellent! Smart guy that understands people and is down to earth! Teaches negotiations course- one of the best courses and profs I had in my 4 years.
